title: Villager News Nov 15
summary: Voxel has never been busier, we fought the Ender Dragon, and welcomed two new players!

ticker.label: Villager News
items: I just got a cute cat
Local chicken refuses to explain itself
Creeper seen being polite, experts confused
Sheep demands to be dyed purple
Man digs straight down, has regrets
Please stop putting cake in chests
Cow stares at wall for six hours
Witnesses say the cactus started it
Torch shortage feared after cave trip
If you can read this, you are reading

blocks.text: Actually, I don’t really know why I said that. There hasn’t been much new news this week.

Oh, a buddy of mine became a farmer! That’s **big news.** He sells apples though, so I guess that makes him an arborist. Or an orchardist? Is that a word? *I should look it up in the Bloxford Villager Dictionary…*
We also defeated **the Ender Dragon** and had our busiest week on Voxel since…forever. That’s cool.
OH!

pages.sign: THE ENDER DRAGON HAS BEEN DEFEATED!

blocks.text: Yesterday at around **20:00** a group of brave warriors gathered around the portal.
They did some witchy magic to activate it, *something nasty with eyeballs I believe,* and went on through.
Our correspondent, Villager #9 was on the scene. Here's the report:
"IT'S RAINING DRAGON FIRE!"
Sounds rough, Villager #9. Do you have any armour on you?
"HAD SOME"
Where is it?
"SCATTERED AND DESPAWNED 5 MINUTES AGO!"
Is there anything we can do for you?
"BRING ME SOME STEW!"
What kind?
"SUSPICIOUS"
Alright, we'll get on that.
Our CSIs have confirmed that the Dragon was killed at precisely **20:25** by
Detective_Mikey (Michael)!
**What a feat!**
That Detective_Mikey is such a cool dude, freeing the End and the Endermen from their tyrannical overlord, the Big Bad Dragon…
Wow, that's just mean to the Endermen.

pages.sign: THE FIRST ELYTRA HAVE BEEN CLAIMED!

blocks.text: Well, besides that, we have some other accolades to give. Six people have already claimed an **Elytra**, but the first one was...
EchoinSilence (Lucas)!
A round of applause, please!

blocks.lead: Remember: Voxel has a limit of one Elytra per person, so you can't ask someone else to get it for you.

blocks.text: A lot of the End Ships nearby have already been looted, so if you don't have an Elytra yet, you might need to go a bit further.
*That's not an issue, however, with today's sponsor!*

blocks.lead: *The Flying Dutchman and Co.* is truly a one-stop shop! From Happy Ghast starter kits to bulk deliveries, and now...**the End Taxi Service!**

blocks.text: For all those folks who really want an Elytra but don't want to take endless stacks of cobblestone with them to bridge across the gaps between End islands, there's the **End Taxi Service.**
More information will be posted in the Discord!
Huh? What do you mean we can't find the **Dragon Egg?**
No, I understand that it's missing, but how do you lose a Dragon Egg? It's huge!
Have we checked the portal? And it's not there? Well, that's just *wonderful.*
Well, yeah, of course I think it should be in a museum, but we can't put it in the museum if it's *missing.*
If any upstanding citizen feels compelled to gift the Dragon Egg to the museum, that would be most appreciated. To sweeten the deal, we could even put a **plaque** underneath it with their name.
You know, for their contribution to history. And not because we're desperate.
Was there more?
Of course!

Last Wednesday, the 11th of November, was officially the **busiest day**Voxel has ever seen, with **11 people** online at once and a whopping **67.5 hours** of combined playtime between the 15 people who were online that day. ***That's crazy.***

blocks.lead: Crazy? I was crazy once. They made me play a game. A game filled with blocks. Blocks make me crazy. Crazy? I wa-

blocks.text: We're also happy to announce two new players on the server:
Senna_Roereitje (Senna) and xXWarCryXx (Luuk)!
Welcome to Voxel! We're looking forward to seeing what you'll get up to.
ilyAfterLife (Thijmen) opened a new Butcher Shop.

items.text:
Cooked Steak
Cooked Porkchops
Cooked Chicken
Leather

blocks.lead: Located next to *Rocket Science* in the Shopping District!

blocks.text: IT'S ALWAYS RAINING IN THIS DAMN VILLAGE!
Sorry, that was uncalled for, but yes, **Wooly** has confirmed that it's always raining.
